objective: Proof: on a consistent parity law, whose knots are the circuits of size at least three of a binary matroid, a chain of knots from x to y (each sharing a distinction with the next) always has a knot through x and y inside its union, unless x and y are parallel. So chain distance counted in knots is 1 or infinite (no spacing), and counted in distinctions it equals bond distance plus one. Check: every pair of intersecting knots up to a declared size, and every pair of distinctions, on finite windows of the parity laws measured since 2026-11-07 (gauge, Tseitin, Ledrappier).
status: Proved (BOND-CHAIN-20261108-001A-P001): on a consistent parity law two non-parallel distinctions joined by a chain of knots lie on a knot inside the chain's union, so chain distance counted in knots is 1 (no spacing) and counted in distinctions equals bond distance; checked on gauge, Tseitin and Ledrappier windows.
title: Chains on parity laws
